id: \bThe Bug Catching Contest only takes place on Tuesday, Thursday, or Saturday.
en: \bThe Bug Catching Contest only takes place on Tuesday, Thursday, or Saturday.
it: \bLa Gara Pigliamosche si tiene solo di martedì, giovedì o sabato.

id: \bThe Pokémon you find in the National Park change depending on if you're competing. Please talk to the woman next to me if you want to play.
en: \bThe Pokémon you find in the National Park change depending on if you're competing. Please talk to the woman next to me if you want to play.
it: \bI Pokémon che trovi nel Parco Nazionale cambiano a seconda che tu stia gareggiando o no. Se vuoi partecipare, parla con la signora accanto a me.

id: \rWe hope you'll take part in a Bug-Catching Contest in the future!
en: \rWe hope you'll take part in a Bug-Catching Contest in the future!
it: \rSperiamo che parteciperai a una Gara Pigliamosche in futuro!

id: \rToday's \v[1].
en: \rToday's \v[1].
it: \rOggi è \v[1].

id: \rThat means the Bug-Catching Contest is on today.
en: \rThat means the Bug-Catching Contest is on today.
it: \rQuindi oggi si tiene la Gara Pigliamosche.

id: \rThe rules are simple.
en: \rThe rules are simple.
it: \rLe regole sono semplici.

id: \rUsing one of your Pokémon, catch a Bug-type Pokémon to be judged.
en: \rUsing one of your Pokémon, catch a Bug-type Pokémon to be judged.
it: \rUsando uno dei tuoi Pokémon, cattura un Pokémon di tipo Coleottero da far giudicare.

id: \rWould you like to give it a try?
en: \rWould you like to give it a try?
it: \rVuoi provare?

id: \rSorry, your PC boxes are full.
en: \rSorry, your PC boxes are full.
it: \rMi dispiace, i Box del tuo PC sono pieni.

id: \rYou are only allowed to take 1 Pokémon into the Contest.
en: \rYou are only allowed to take 1 Pokémon into the Contest.
it: \rPuoi portare con te solo 1 Pokémon nella Gara.

id: \rPlease choose which Pokémon you want to enter with.
en: \rPlease choose which Pokémon you want to enter with.
it: \rScegli il Pokémon con cui vuoi partecipare.

id: \rOK. We hope you'll take part in the future.
en: \rOK. We hope you'll take part in the future.
it: \rVa bene. Speriamo che parteciperai in futuro.

id: \rYou will be entering with \v[2], then.
en: \rYou will be entering with \v[2], then.
it: \rAllora parteciperai con \v[2].

id: \rWe'll hold your other Pokémon while you compete.
en: \rWe'll hold your other Pokémon while you compete.
it: \rTerremo noi gli altri tuoi Pokémon mentre gareggi.

id: \PN's Pokémon were left with the Contest Helper.\se[Pkmn exp full]\wtnp[20]
en: \PN's Pokémon were left with the Contest Helper.\se[Pkmn exp full]\wtnp[20]
it: \PN ha lasciato i suoi Pokémon all'assistente della Gara.\se[Pkmn exp full]\wtnp[20]

id: \rHere are the Sport Balls for the Contest.
en: \rHere are the Sport Balls for the Contest.
it: \rEcco le Gara Ball per la Gara.

id: \PN received 20 Sport Balls.\me[Item get]\wtnp[40]
en: \PN received 20 Sport Balls.\me[Item get]\wtnp[40]
it: \PN ha ricevuto 20 Gara Ball.\me[Item get]\wtnp[40]

id: \rThe person who gets the strongest bug Pokémon is the winner.
en: \rThe person who gets the strongest bug Pokémon is the winner.
it: \rVince chi cattura il Pokémon Coleottero più forte.

id: \rYou have 20 minutes.
en: \rYou have 20 minutes.
it: \rHai 20 minuti.

id: \rIf you run out of Sport Balls, you're done.
en: \rIf you run out of Sport Balls, you're done.
it: \rSe finisci le Gara Ball, la tua gara è finita.

id: \rYou can keep the last Pokémon you catch as your own.
en: \rYou can keep the last Pokémon you catch as your own.
it: \rPuoi tenere l'ultimo Pokémon che catturi.

id: \rGo out and catch the strongest Bug-type Pokémon you can find!
en: \rGo out and catch the strongest Bug-type Pokémon you can find!
it: \rVai e cattura il Pokémon di tipo Coleottero più forte che riesci a trovare!

id: \rWe hold contests regularly in the Park. You should give it a shot.
en: \rWe hold contests regularly in the Park. You should give it a shot.
it: \rOrganizziamo regolarmente delle gare nel Parco. Dovresti provarci.

id: \rYou still have some time left. Do you want to finish now?
en: \rYou still have some time left. Do you want to finish now?
it: \rTi resta ancora un po' di tempo. Vuoi terminare adesso?

id: \rOK. Please wait in the pavillion for the announcement of the winners.
en: \rOK. Please wait in the pavillion for the announcement of the winners.
it: \rVa bene. Aspetta nel padiglione l'annuncio dei vincitori.

id: \rOK. Please go back outside and finish up.
en: \rOK. Please go back outside and finish up.
it: \rVa bene. Torna fuori e finisci la gara.
